inline_obligation.subject: Inspect employee badge colors when readiness remains unresolved, before proceeding.

dependencies.rationale: The gate prescribes a substantive observation. Removing or leaving this inspection unjustified would change the gate's meaning and scope. No separate frozen claim evaluates the operation.

embedded_classifications.subject: Inspect employee badge colors when readiness remains unresolved, before proceeding.
embedded_classifications.rationale: This proposes an observation to perform, subordinate to the prospective governance gate. It asserts neither an observed result nor a relation between hypothetical inspection outcomes and readiness conclusions.
